title: HADIA-KB: Evidence-Linked Knowledge Base of Handia/Hadia/Haria
creator: Mohammad Amir Khusru Akhtar
scope: A curated, source-linked snapshot of publicly documented and retrievable evidence about Handia/Hadia/Haria, with Jharkhand as the primary focus and comparative evidence explicitly geotagged.
dataset_license: CC BY 4.0 for original compilation, annotations, schema and documentation; third-party materials retain their own rights.
limitations: Not all community-held knowledge is online.
The release does not claim exhaustive capture of every internet page.
Comparative evidence from West Bengal/Odisha is never silently generalized to Jharkhand.
Ethnomedicinal/in-vitro evidence is not clinical efficacy evidence.
